description: Policy assumptions used to construct willingness-to-pay thresholds.
reference: Project economic-policy assumptions; GDP and exchange-rate inputs should be updated to a named source and common price year for the final analysis.

gdp_per_capita.description: GDP-per-capita values used in threshold calculations. Currency figures must represent the same year and conversion basis.
gdp_per_capita.reference: Existing project values; verify and replace with a dated World Bank, Statistical Center of Iran, or other explicitly selected official source.

wtp_multiplier.description: Multipliers applied to GDP per capita for standard and rare-disease threshold scenarios. These are policy scenarios, not empirical treatment-effect inputs.
wtp_multiplier.reference: Project policy assumptions. The value of 3 reflects a legacy GDP-multiple convention; the rare-disease value of 10 is an explicit scenario assumption and should not be presented as an official Iranian threshold.
